title: A site conversation is sent the redesign/build tools only once that road starts, and has them by the next step after its trigger
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/deferred-tools.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/surface-listener.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the result of each named test.
expect: Every known surface (WordPress open/sealed/bound, Joomla open/sealed, EmDash) is made without tracy_brand, tracy_design_library, tracy_design_copy, tracy_design_propose and the WordPress/Joomla build tools, except tracy_site_build_joomla where the sealed Joomla tracy_site names it.

The design skill loaded, an answer naming a deferred tool, or the Design inspiration / Build tab's words in each of the 8 interface languages lift the tools before the next step; an ordinary edit lifts none; a resumed conversation keeps every tool it was already sent.

On dsh's own ToolRuntime the lifted tools join the agent's view, and dsh's addition-only projection keeps the first declarations unchanged and sends the new ones deferLoading with their tool-addition block.
evidence: harness-opt profile 09/10/2026 §1/§6 candidate 4: 0 calls of these tools in 341 bench turns of editing; ~3.9k (all CMS) to ~8.5k (WordPress, open Joomla) characters of schema on every step.
fence: agent/created defers by restriction; triggers lift by the restriction's own disposer before the step that needs the tool; nothing is ever removed or re-described.

tests: 🔒 every known surface is made without the deferred tools
🔒 a deferred tool is there by the next step
🔒 a resumed conversation keeps every tool
